phase_policy: A phase may start only after the preceding phase commit, tester gate, and independent reviewer gate are green; any missing evidence blocks advancement.

phases.name: Executable migration map
phases.git_commit_boundary: Commit only the plan, manifest, manifest test, tracker, and deepwork progress after all P1 checks pass.
phases.reviewer_gate: Independent reviewer confirms factual inventory, complete classifications, no false legacy designation, and no runtime behavior change.
phases.tester_gate: python -m unittest tests.test_writer_migration_manifest -v; python -m json.tool config/writer_migration_manifest.json; git diff --check
phases.rollback: Revert the single P1 documentation-and-manifest commit; runtime remains untouched.

phases.name: Compatibility-first public CLI facade
phases.git_commit_boundary: Commit the new scripts/writer/cli.py facade and compatibility tests without relocating internals.
phases.reviewer_gate: Independent reviewer verifies one public command surface, fail-closed dispatch, unchanged old entrypoints, and no circular imports.
phases.tester_gate: Run CLI help and command-parity tests for plan, draftcheck, live-cycle, extract, graphs, annotate, consolidate, vectorsim, dom, review, uncertainty, register, draft-loop, verify-claims, and citation-trace.
phases.rollback: Revert the P2 facade commit; all existing entrypoints remain callable.

phases.name: Canonical layers and extractor decision
phases.git_commit_boundary: Commit package scaffolding, extractor benchmark fixtures/results, selected extractor implementation, and old-import adapters as one independently revertible boundary.
phases.reviewer_gate: Independent reviewer verifies dependency direction, parity evidence, stable spans/reason codes, and that the losing branch is only adapted, not yet archived.
phases.tester_gate: Run extractor parity benchmark plus tests/test_draft_loop.py, tests/test_citation_trace.py, and semantic extraction tests through old and new imports.
phases.rollback: Revert P3 and route the P2 facade back to both original extractor trees.

phases.name: Research contract adapter and aggregate release gate
phases.git_commit_boundary: Commit the read-only researcher-to-writer adapter, release gate, fixtures, and compatibility shims together.
phases.reviewer_gate: Independent reviewer verifies Writer cannot mutate researcher authority and release cannot proceed without verification then traceability evidence.
phases.tester_gate: Run adapter schema tests and aggregate cases: verification failure blocks citation/release, verification success proceeds, and citation failure blocks release.
phases.rollback: Revert P4; retain documented verify_claims then citation_trace sequence and independent old commands.

phases.name: Semantic runtime relocation and authority updates
phases.git_commit_boundary: Commit semantic runtime/assets relocation with all provider, environment, agent, skill, documentation, and test reference updates.
phases.reviewer_gate: Independent reviewer performs tracked-reference and import-boundary scans and confirms specialized roles remain separate.
phases.tester_gate: Run Writer Core boundary tests, root writer tests, capability preflight/bundle routing, py_compile/import smoke, and old-entrypoint compatibility tests.
phases.rollback: Revert P5 as a unit; P2 adapters continue to resolve the original scripts/writer-core runtime.

phases.name: Legacy archive after zero-reference proof
phases.git_commit_boundary: Commit only proven superseded branches and the complete versioned handoff unit under легаси/writer/ with provenance records.
phases.reviewer_gate: Independent reviewer verifies zero runtime/config/agent/test references, green replacement acceptance, complete handoff unit, provenance, and rollback mapping.
phases.tester_gate: Run tracked-reference scans, full Writer suite, route/preflight tests, archive inventory/hash check, and git diff --check.
phases.rollback: Revert P6 to restore archived paths byte-for-byte; do not reconstruct files from selected archive fragments.

phases.name: Recursive live deployment and final audit
phases.git_commit_boundary: Commit recursive writer sync support, deployment tests, final runbook, and regenerated capability snapshot only after dry-run evidence.
phases.reviewer_gate: Independent reviewer compares tracked canonical Writer files with the dry-run deployment plan and checks no shared subsystem was relocated.
phases.tester_gate: Run sync dry-run tests, environment validation, capability preflight, writing-stage bundle resolution, health_check.py, full Writer suite, and git diff --check.
phases.rollback: Revert P7 and restore the prior live mirror from its pre-deploy backup; canonical repository runtime remains at P6.

experiments.design_choice: Select or compose the canonical implementation for the five shared extractor modules without changing observable Writer behavior.
experiments.baseline: Run both current trees unchanged: scripts/writer/extractor and scripts/writer-core/v2_extractor. Record outputs and timings before selecting a candidate.
experiments.benchmark: python -m unittest tests.test_writer_extractor_parity -v on checked-in shared fixtures, including numeric, span, classification, context, and graph cases.
metrics: behavioral parity percentage on shared fixtures
median runtime over a fixed repeated fixture set
direct import/dependency count and optional dependency failures
experiments.stop_rule: Do not consolidate while shared-fixture behavioral parity is below 100% or any span/reason-code difference lacks an accepted compatibility decision. If both candidates are equivalent, stop after one fixed benchmark run and choose the lower dependency cost; use runtime only as a tie-breaker, not as permission to change behavior.
